transport_zip_sha256.basis: GitHub-reported outer transport digest, not locally recomputed; this differs from the separately retained API export ZIP whose bytes are included and rehashed.

full_extracted_inventory_digest.encoding: SHA256 of sorted compact UTF8 JSON relativepath->{bytes,sha256}; matches accepted complete artifact audit

full_bundle.availability: Complete extracted artifact retained locally; this public slice intentionally excludes DB/queue/host/runtime data and is not the whole bundle.

selection_policy: Raw exact source manifest, native source/checker/contracts/experiments/stimuli/observations/checks/results, arithmetic trace, validation status, replay request and inspected safe export. Exclude all DB snapshots/campaign rows, queue metadata, host/runtime environment/job/logs, waveforms and unchecked files. No raw summary/application-summary copied because they mix omitted runtime/queue data.

derived_execution_summary.acceptance: Main confirmed independent seven-outcome/replay/export bounded ephemeral API gate audit; no new execution by curation.

source_configuration.transformation: Only parameters and source basename projected from omitted runtime job; build/output/host or container paths excluded.

exact_replay.operation: Actual reexecution of the same curated native plan; not saved-compiled-executable reuse, a candidate repair or model/provider action.
